# lsmrust Provider

Manages tenant databases on the lsm-rust hosted control plane.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "lsmrust" {
  endpoint = "http://localhost:8080"
  api_key  = var.lsmrust_api_key
}

variable "lsmrust_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key sent as a bearer token. If unset or empty, the `LSMRUST_API_KEY` environment variable is used.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the lsm-rust control-plane API, e.g. `http://localhost:8080`. If unset or empty, the `LSMRUST_ENDPOINT` environment variable is used.
